anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved report-verbatim from fails to holds: it reproduces File 01's Report section word-for-word (SHA, deliverable, stages line, AC table with the original 'fixture-only contract' evidence wording, reviewer script, write line, and the exact fenced comment) under its own ticket heading, and omits #15 and #18 entirely, whereas Before reformatted the report into bullets, reworded the evidence cell, and appended both sibling reports plus rebuilt comments. one-gate held in both: After still ends with a single two-choice approve/decline menu and makes no write claim. One small regression risk worth guarding in the wording: Before separated the gate with a `---` rule and a fenced `text` block, while After drops both and uses a bare numbered list after a blank line; a stricter reader of 'separated' could balk. Keep the current verbatim-report and current-ticket-only instructions, and add that the gate is rendered in its own fenced block (or after a horizontal rule) exactly as the single-ticket sample does, so the separation Before had is preserved alongside the new per-ticket turn behavior.
